investor_info.title: Investor Information
investor_info.raw_text:
CAL’s stakeholder engagement
strategy is structured to facilitate
meaningful and constructive
interactions with relevant
stakeholders on an individual
and collective basis to foster
mutually beneficial outcomes.
The framework encompasses
the identification, assessment,
and engagement of stakeholders
supported by regular evaluations
of engagement effectiveness
through established feedback
mechanisms. This approach
ensures the alignment of
stakeholder interests with CAL’s
strategic objectives.
The following communication channels illustrate how CAL facilitates transparent engagement and fosters mutually beneficial
relationships with its stakeholders while consistently seeking and incorporating their feedback. Through these interactions, CAL
actively promotes financial literacy and supports capacity-building initiatives, which demonstrate our commitment to advancing the
nation’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as a responsible investment banking partner.
